newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EDP sale delayed until June - paper.
newsitem.headline: EDP sale delayed until June - paper.

text.p: The partial privatisation of Portuguese utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal has been delayed from May until mid-June, a Lisbon newspaper reported.
Publico newspaper quoted Under-Secretary for Industry and Energy, Jose Penedos, as saying that the reason for the delay was that the sale of France Telecom would take place in May.
Penedos said a probable date for the partial privatisation of EDP was June 16.

France will sell between 30 and 50 billion francs of France Telecom shares in the coming months, starting with a three-week reservation period for private individuals on May 6 and the official sale from May 27.
"We have admitted that our operation (EDP privatisation) could be affected by another significant one, and the France Telecom selloff competes with EDP," Penedos told Publico.
The Socialist government of Prime Minister Antonio Guterres has said it planned to sell off up to 49 percent of EDP, Portugal's dominant electricity generator and distributor.
Government officials were not immediately available to comment on the newspaper report.
